ITEM 1 | Dark brown cubes with charred, browned edges and a crisp-looking surface, roughly 2-3 cm pieces, matte with slight glaze, clustered in the upper left of the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-tan cubes with a soft, slightly glossy surface, about 2 cm, interspersed among the browned cubes and along the lower left edge | 60
ITEM 3 | Light golden-yellow chunks with a smooth, firm, slightly oily surface, about 2-3 cm, sitting near the center right and lower left | 70
ITEM 4 | Pale green long slices with darker green skin edges and slightly translucent, softened flesh, about 5-7 cm long, lying flat along the lower left and center | 50
ITEM 5 | Bright green florets with dark green tops, about 3 cm across, slightly bumpy and moist, at the lower right of the cluster | 30
ITEM 6 | Small red-orange piece with a glossy, soft skin, about 2 cm, sitting among the green vegetables in the center | 10
ITEM 7 | Dark purple-black small pieces with a shiny, wrinkled skin, about 1-2 cm, near the center beside the red piece | 8
ITEM 8 | Pale beige crumbly crumbs and small bits scattered around the plate edges and beneath the vegetables, dry and granular | 5
ITEM 9 | Pale yellow-tan chunk with soft, smooth, matte surface, about 3 cm, sitting at the right edge of the cluster, slightly glossy | 45
